result.summary: The page is mostly well-composed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical duplicate restaurant cards (same name, image, ETA, and delivery fee), which looks like a data/rendering bug. A minor contrast concern exists in the search placeholder text. Carousel edge clipping and bottom-viewport cutoff were treated as expected behavior per instructions.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row displays two consecutive cards that are exact duplicates: both are 'Green Bowl Poké' with the same dish image, '15–25 min' badge, and '€0.90 delivery' text. This repetition looks like broken/duplicated data rather than intentional content and reduces the usefulness of the carousel.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate restaurant entries in the carousel data source so each venue appears only once; if multiple locations exist, differentiate them with location names or distinct imagery.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text color to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against the input background, or provide a visible label.
